summary: ANVI Global Holdings filed an 8-K after a holder of 72,000,000 shares (about 60.03% of 119,950,000 voting shares) executed a written consent on September 4, 2026 approving a 1-for-20 reverse stock split. The board approved and recommended the split on August 29, 2026. No meeting or vote is required under Nevada law; a Schedule 14C information statement will be mailed, and effectiveness follows a 20-day waiting period plus SEC and FINRA clearance. Separately, an OTCQB bid-price deficiency notice dated June 6, 2026 set an October 5, 2026 cure deadline. Watch FINRA/14C timing and any contemplated mining-asset contribution.
